Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: WHOLE-FIGURE pixel-art locomotion sprites for the existing native64 square-grid roguelike. INPUT1 is the exact canonical appearance, anatomy, palette, VIEW and silhouette proportions. INPUT2 is the SAME creature's opposite view, solely to clarify anatomy/material ownership; it is NOT a different species and must NOT replace the INPUT1 camera.
Layout EXACTLY THREE equal columns by THREE equal rows. First eight separate COMPLETE FIGURES in row-major order form one smooth restrained 800ms cycle (400ms per advancement). Ninth figure is a real fully supported resting idle. Every figure has identical scale and camera; complete head, abdomen, every leg, claw and original appendage inside its own cell with generous transparent margins. No clipping or overlap.
Retain canonical body length, height, width, limb thickness, segment count, material coverage and attachment points. Native width/height ratios must stay within 5-8% of the stated master dimensions throughout the cycle; do not slim, bulk, shrink or stretch the species. Coherently draw the ENTIRE creature in each phase; head, neck/thorax, abdomen and appendages move as attached anatomy. Very small vertical bob and restrained weight transfer. Not a detached sliding segment, procedural legs, a standing human walk, hopping, running, flight or wide splits.
Exact slightly elevated FRONT or REAR square-grid game camera from INPUT1. Parallel axes, neither profile, pure top-down nor isometric diamond. Crisp deliberate native64-readable pixel clusters with dark clean outlines, original muted matte materials. Do not lighten skin/chitin, bleach joints, add glossy shine, rimlight, glow, blur, grain or 3D/painterly rendering. Colored outer fringe dots in the master are export noise; do not redraw those dots.
Genuine transparent alphaZERO outside the real silhouettes and in gaps. No matte, checkerboard, floor, cast shadow, text, labels, grid, watermark or border. No invented limb, antenna, tail, horn, wing, clothes, held weapon or new face. Preserve anatomy and exact original appendage count.
SUBJECT: the SMALL LOW RED/CHARCOAL SIX-LEGGED chitin creature. EXACTLY SIX angular walking legs in THREE attached paired rows: front, middle, rear. Preserve distinct leg ownership, pale joint bands, sharp dark foot tips, raised red segmented back/spines and small lowered head with original mouth/mandibles. Do not replace it with an eight-legged spider or a four-legged dog. Native FRONT47wide x36high; REAR47wide x37high. Keep original compact broad body. No antenna, wing, long tail, huge eyes or humanoid face.
Gait: slow alternating tripods with at least three grounded feet. Group A = anatomical front-left + middle-right + rear-left; group B = front-right + middle-left + rear-right. 1groupA contact/groupB trailing,2weight loads onto A,3B advances LOW with each foot separated,4B touches,5groupB support/A trailing,6weight loads onto B,7A advances LOW,8A touches to close cycle. Front, middle and rear feet remain attached to their proper segments, never merge into each other or disappear; partly occluded far legs still belong to the figure. Body stays low, supported and nearly level.
VIEW: FRONT, moving DOWN toward viewer. Keep the master front head/mouth and frontal materials.
